_comment: Which Nexus file slot each release asset is uploaded to. Read by .github/workflows/publish-to-nexus.yml.
These ids are public on the mod page, so they are checked in rather than hidden in a secret. Only
the API key is a secret.
mod_id is the COMPOSITE UID, not the number in the page URL. The v3 API composes it as
(gameId << 32 | modId), and the upload action passes it straight through to POST
/mods/{id}/changelogs. For this mod that is 9966 << 32 | 1 = 42803644071937. The page URL says
mods/1, and sending 1 would address a different mod entirely. Find it in the Advanced view, or
recompose it: gameId = uid >> 32, modId = uid & 0xFFFFFFFF.
file_id is an ordinary file id, not a composite. If an upload fails with a 403 or a 404 on the
file, check that id space first.
asset is the release asset name without the version and the .zip; the workflow forms
AS2ModApi-0.2.2.zip from it and the tag.
ONLY LIST SLOTS THAT EXIST. The upload action adds a version to a slot; it cannot create the mod
page or the slot. A release asset with no entry here is skipped, and the workflow warns by name
so a missing slot cannot pass unnoticed. To add one: upload that zip to the mod page by hand
once, read its file id off Manage Files, and add it below.
Exactly one entry sets changelog and update_mod_version. All slots live on one mod page, so two
entries claiming either would post the changelog twice and set the page version twice.
primary_mod_manager_download decides which file Vortex fetches from the mod manager download
button. Leave every entry false to keep whatever the page is already set to.
